Route all user data paths through platform abstractions

centralized bivvy_data_dir() and bivvy_config_dir() functions
that delegate to the existing sys::data_dir() and a new

macOS paths move under ~/Library/Application Support/bivvy.
On Windows they use %APPDATA%/bivvy.

Affected subsystems: state, snapshots, logs, registry,
telemetry, trust, config loader, auto-update.
EOF
)"

Author: benchmark <benchmark@localhost>
Date:   Tue May 12 16:19:34 2026 -0600

    Route all user data paths through platform abstractions
    
    Replace hardcoded ~/.bivvy paths across all subsystems with
    centralized bivvy_data_dir() and bivvy_config_dir() functions
    that delegate to the existing sys::data_dir() and a new
    sys::config_dir() abstraction.
    
    On Linux this respects XDG_DATA_HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME. On
    macOS paths move under ~/Library/Application Support/bivvy.
    On Windows they use %APPDATA%/bivvy.
    
    Affected subsystems: state, snapshots, logs, registry,
    telemetry, trust, config loader, auto-update.

Route all user data paths through platform abstractions

Replace hardcoded ~/.bivvy paths across all subsystems with
centralized bivvy_data_dir() and bivvy_config_dir() functions
that delegate to the existing sys::data_dir() and a new
sys::config_dir() abstraction.

On Linux this respects XDG_DATA_HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME. On
macOS paths move under ~/Library/Application Support/bivvy.
On Windows they use %APPDATA%/bivvy.

Affected subsystems: state, snapshots, logs, registry,
telemetry, trust, config loader, auto-update.
EOF
)"

Author: benchmark <benchmark@localhost>

    Route all user data paths through platform abstractions
    
    Replace hardcoded ~/.bivvy paths across all subsystems with
    centralized bivvy_data_dir() and bivvy_config_dir() functions
    that delegate to the existing sys::data_dir() and a new
    sys::config_dir() abstraction.
    
    On Linux this respects XDG_DATA_HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME. On
    macOS paths move under ~/Library/Application Support/bivvy.
    On Windows they use %APPDATA%/bivvy.
    
    Affected subsystems: state, snapshots, logs, registry,
    telemetry, trust, config loader, auto-update.

Author: benchmark <benchmark@localhost>
Date:   Tue May 12 16:19:34 2026 -0600

    Route all user data paths through platform abstractions
    
    Replace hardcoded ~/.bivvy paths across all subsystems with
    centralized bivvy_data_dir() and bivvy_config_dir() functions
    that delegate to the existing sys::data_dir() and a new
    sys::config_dir() abstraction.
    
    On Linux this respects XDG_DATA_HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME. On
    macOS paths move under ~/Library/Application Support/bivvy.
    On Windows they use %APPDATA%/bivvy.
    
    Affected subsystems: state, snapshots, logs, registry,
    telemetry, trust, config loader, auto-update.

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Route all user data paths through platform abstractions

Replace hardcoded ~/.bivvy paths across all subsystems with
centralized bivvy_data_dir() and bivvy_config_dir() functions
that delegate to the existing sys::data_dir() and a new
sys::config_dir() abstraction.

On Linux this respects XDG_DATA_HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME. On
macOS paths move under ~/Library/Application Support/bivvy.
On Windows they use %APPDATA%/bivvy.

Affected subsystems: state, snapshots, logs, registry,
telemetry, trust, config loader, auto-update.
EOF
)"

    Route all user data paths through platform abstractions
    
    Replace hardcoded ~/.bivvy paths across all subsystems with
    centralized bivvy_data_dir() and bivvy_config_dir() functions
    that delegate to the existing sys::data_dir() and a new
    sys::config_dir() abstraction.
    
    On Linux this respects XDG_DATA_HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME. On
    macOS paths move under ~/Library/Application Support/bivvy.
    On Windows they use %APPDATA%/bivvy.
    
    Affected subsystems: state, snapshots, logs, registry,
    telemetry, trust, config loader, auto-update.
